conditions: In `OrdinaryGet(O, P, Receiver)`, `O.[[GetOwnProperty]](P)` completes normally with `undefined` and the subsequent `O.[[GetPrototypeOf]]()` completes normally.
limitations: An existing own descriptor follows the later data or accessor branch.
Delegated `[[Get]]` can complete normally or throw. The claim addresses the missing-descriptor branch of OrdinaryGet.

triggers: Controlling edition correction, applicability change, or material counterexample.

statement: ECMAScript 2024 OrdinaryGet, when it finds no own descriptor, returns undefined if the prototype is null and otherwise delegates to the prototype's [[Get]] with the same property key and receiver.
